theme: Graphite GPU backend and Skia m152
highlights_headline: 4.152.0 adds Graphite GPU backend bindings for Vulkan, Metal and Dawn, built on Skia m152.
highlights_body: It also lands async pixel readback, several native use-after-free and memory-leak fixes, a new SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package, and a round of interop performance work.

bullets.lead: Skia updated to Chrome milestone m152
bullets.detail: Bundles the m152 engine along with merged upstream chrome/m151 and m152 bug fixes.
Adds bindings for Skia's new Graphite GPU backend across Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn, alongside a new SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package and Vulkan test coverage on Android and Linux.
Adds a backend-neutral RequestReadPixels API to SKImage and SKSurface for asynchronous pixel access.
Uses FreeType to provide font support on Windows Nano Server.
Fixes crashes from a use-after-free in SKRegion.SpanIterator and in SKPixmap.ExtractSubset and its With* methods by properly rooting the source objects.
Fixes a native memory leak on the SKImage.Create raster failure path.
Stops pinning a default Windows SDK version and initializes the MSVC environment once per native build, reducing native build flakiness.

contributor_summaries.jeffska: Improved Nano Server font support by switching to FreeType
contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Added the Graphite GPU backend bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn

preview_summaries.v4.152.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 introduced the Graphite GPU backend bindings, async pixel readback, the new SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package, several native use-after-free and memory-leak fixes, and updated Skia through the m151 and m152 lines.

harfbuzz_summary: Refreshes the bundled HarfBuzz engine as part of the Skia m152 update.
